$comment: THE MODEL REGISTRY — this is what 'run it on the model of my choice' means.
A receipt is worthless unless it names the EXACT weights that answered, so
every run still pins a model file and its sha256. What this file changes is
WHERE that pin comes from: looked up by key at authoring time instead of
typed into a hand-written manifest per model. Adding a model is one entry
here, not a new set of manifests.
sha256 / tokenizerSha256 may be null. `bench hash <key>` and
`bench tokenizer <key>` compute and write them back. A publishable run
refuses while they are null; a development run says so out loud.
servedId is what the server's /v1/models endpoint reports for these
weights. It is what an identity arm compares a lane's live route against,
and it is NOT always the filename.
Choose a model key per comparison. qwen3.8-27b is the original Q8_0 baseline; qwen3.8-27b-uncensored-hauhaucs is a separate artifact and result series. Never overwrite one with the other.

gemma-4-31b.label: Gemma 4 31B Q8_0 — the prior substrate, every historic run pins this
